summary: Generation Income Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a property sale by its indirect wholly owned subsidiary GIPFL 10002 N Dale Mabry, LLC. The asset was a Starbucks-occupied net lease retail property in Tampa, Florida, sold to Andrew Livingstone (later assigned to 10002 N Dale Mabry, LLC) for $2,964,000, yielding net proceeds of $1,959,170 after prorations. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the sale appears independent. Pro forma financials adjust for the disposition as if closed January 1, 2025. Watch for use of proceeds and any further portfolio streamlining.
